LanguageData.Ritual_GrantPharna.label: Grant Pharna
LanguageData.Ritual_GrantPharna.description: The Archotech bestows Pharna upon the recipient, making them a member of the Familia.
LanguageData.Ritual_AscendPharna.label: Ascend Pharna
